payload.text:
Prove this Lean 4 theorem (source: FATE-H, difficulty: medium).

Informal statement:
Let H be a subgroup of G with index n. Prove that there is a normal subgroup K of G contained in H such that the index of K in G is at most n factorial.

Formal statement to prove:
theorem fateh_001_subgroup_normal_index_le_factorial {G : Type} [Group G] {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (H : Subgroup G) (hH : H.index = n) :
    ∃ K : Subgroup G, K.Normal ∧ K ≤ H ∧ K.index ≠ 0 ∧ K.index ≤ n.factorial

Use the typed subgoal tools to decompose, verify, review, and route. For this medium task, define four to six concrete compile-verifiable artifacts; do not use vague understand/find/investigate subgoals. Build at least two work subgoals plus one final integration subgoal; use sequential dependencies when the mathematics is sequential. Do not use HANDOFF or VERDICT text markers. Use search_lemmas and compiler tools when they resolve real uncertainty. Hand off only when the receiving role can act on concrete mathematical, compiler, or review evidence. A non-linear route is allowed, but extra communication is not itself success. The final proof must compile, preserve the exact statement, and contain no sorry, admit, or added axiom.

{"code":"theorem fateh_001_subgroup_normal_index_le_factorial {G : Type} [Group G] {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (H : Subgroup G) (hH : H.index = n) :
    ∃ K : Subgroup G, K.Normal ∧ K ≤ H ∧ K.index ≠ 0 ∧ K.index ≤ n.factorial := by
  -- Use the normal core of H as K
  let K := H.normalCore
  have hK_normal : K.Normal := Subgroup.normalCore_normal H
  have hK_le_H : K ≤ H := Subgroup.normalCore_le H
  -- The kernel of the permutation homomorphism equals the normal core
  have hK_eq_ker : K = (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).ker := by
    rw [← Subgroup.normalCore_eq_ker H]
    rfl
  -- The index of K divides the cardinality of the permutation group
  -- Since G acts on G ⧸ H which has n elements, the image is in Perm (G ⧸ H)
  -- and |Perm (G ⧸ H)| = n!
  -- By the first isomorphism theorem, G/K ≃* (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range
  -- So K.index = |G/K| = |(MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range| ≤ |Perm (G ⧸ H)| = n!
  sorry","subgoal_id":"construct_action_homomorphism","purpose":"subgoal"}

{"code":"theorem fateh_001_subgroup_normal_index_le_factorial {G : Type} [Group G] {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (H : Subgroup G) (hH : H.index = n) :
    ∃ K : Subgroup G, K.Normal ∧ K ≤ H ∧ K.index ≠ 0 ∧ K.index ≤ n.factorial := by
  use H.normalCore
  constructor
  · exact Subgroup.normalCore_normal H
  constructor
  · exact Subgroup.normalCore_le H
  constructor
  · -- Prove K.index ≠ 0
    have h1 : H.normalCore.index = Nat.card (G ⧸ H.normalCore) := by
      rw [Subgroup.index_eq_card]
    have h2 : Nat.card (G ⧸ H.normalCore) ≠ 0 := by
      -- The quotient group is non-empty (contains at least the identity coset)
      have h3 : Nonempty (G ⧸ H.normalCore) := ⟨QuotientGroup.mk 1⟩
      have h4 : Nat.card (G ⧸ H.normalCore) > 0 := by
        apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
        intro h
        have h5 : Fintype.card (G ⧸ H.normalCore) = 0 := by
          simpa [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using h
        have h6 : Fintype.card (G ⧸ H.normalCore) > 0 := by
          apply Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr
          exact ⟨QuotientGroup.mk 1⟩
        linarith
      linarith
    rw [h1]
    exact h2
  · -- Prove K.index ≤ n.factorial
    have h1 : H.normalCore.index = Nat.card (G ⧸ H.normalCore) := by
      rw [Subgroup.index_eq_card]
    have h2 : H.normalCore = (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).ker := by
      rw [Subgroup.normalCore_eq_ker]
    have h3 : G ⧸ H.normalCore ≃* (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
      rw [h2]
      exact Con.quotientKerEquivRange (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H))
    have h4 : Nat.card (G ⧸ H.normalCore) = Nat.card ((MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range) := by
      rw [← h3]
      simp [Nat.card_congr]
    have h5 : Nat.card ((MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range) ≤ Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) := by
      -- The range is a subgroup of the permutation group
      have h6 : (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range ≤ ⊤ := by
        exact Subgroup.top_le
      have h7 : Nat.card ((MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range) ≤ Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) := by
        -- Use the fact that the range is a subgroup
        apply Nat.card_le_of_injective
        exact Subgroup.coe_injective
      exact h7
    have h6 : Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) = (Nat.card (G ⧸ H))! := by
      rw [Nat.card_perm]
    have h7 : Nat.card (G ⧸ H) = n := by
      -- The cardinality of the coset space equals the index
      have h8 : H.index = Nat.card (G ⧸ H) := by
        rw [Subgroup.index_eq_card]
      rw [hH] at h8
      exact h8.symm
    have h8 : Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) = n.factorial := by
      rw [h6, h7]
    have h9 : Nat.card ((MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range) ≤ n.factorial := by
      linarith
    rw [h1, h4]
    exact h9","subgoal_id":"construct_action_homomorphism","purpose":"subgoal"}

    (H : Subgroup G) (hH : H.index = n) :
    ∃ K : Subgroup G, K.Normal ∧ K ≤ H ∧ K.index ≠ 0 ∧ K.index ≤ n.factorial := by
  use H.normalCore
  constructor
  · exact Subgroup.normalCore_normal H
  constructor
  · exact Subgroup.normalCore_le H
  constructor
  · -- Prove K.index ≠ 0
    have h1 : H.normalCore.index = Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
      have h2 : H.normalCore = (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).ker := by
        rw [Subgroup.normalCore_eq_ker]
      rw [h2]
      rw [Subgroup.index_ker]
    have h2 : Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range > 0 := by
      -- The range contains at least the identity permutation
      have h3 : (1 : Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) ∈ (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
        -- The homomorphism maps 1 to 1
        have h4 : MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H) 1 = 1 := by
          simp
        exact Subgroup.mem_range_self 1 h4
      have h4 : Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range ≥ 1 := by
        -- The range is non-empty, so its cardinality is at least 1
        apply Nat.succ_le_of_lt
        apply Nat.card_pos_iff.mpr
        exact ⟨1, h3⟩
      linarith
    rw [h1]
    linarith
  · -- Prove K.index ≤ n.factorial
    have h1 : H.normalCore.index = Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
      have h2 : H.normalCore = (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).ker := by
        rw [Subgroup.normalCore_eq_ker]
      rw [h2]
      rw [Subgroup.index_ker]
    have h2 : Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range ≤ Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) := by
      -- The range is a subgroup of the permutation group
      apply Nat.card_le_of_injective
      exact Subgroup.coe_injective
    have h3 : Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) = (Nat.card (G ⧸ H))! := by
      rw [Nat.card_perm]
    have h4 : Nat.card (G ⧸ H) = n := by
      -- The cardinality of the coset space equals the index
      have h5 : H.index = Nat.card (G ⧸ H) := by
        rw [Subgroup.index_eq_card]
      rw [hH] at h5
      exact h5.symm
    have h5 : Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) = n.factorial := by
      rw [h3, h4]
    have h6 : Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range ≤ n.factorial := by
      linarith
    rw [h1]
    exact h6","subgoal_id":"construct_action_homomorphism","purpose":"subgoal"}

{"code":"theorem fateh_001_subgroup_normal_index_le_factorial {G : Type} [Group G] {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (H : Subgroup G) (hH : H.index = n) :
    ∃ K : Subgroup G, K.Normal ∧ K ≤ H ∧ K.index ≠ 0 ∧ K.index ≤ n.factorial := by
  use H.normalCore
  constructor
  · exact Subgroup.normalCore_normal H
  constructor
  · exact Subgroup.normalCore_le H
  constructor
  · -- Prove K.index ≠ 0
    have h1 : H.normalCore.index = Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
      have h2 : H.normalCore = (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).ker := by
        rw [Subgroup.normalCore_eq_ker]
      rw [h2]
      rw [Subgroup.index_ker]
    have h2 : Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range ≥ 1 := by
      -- The range contains at least the identity permutation
      have h3 : (1 : Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) ∈ (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
        -- The homomorphism maps 1 to 1
        have h4 : MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H) 1 = 1 := by
          simp
        exact Subgroup.mem_range_of_mem 1 (by simp) h4
      -- Since the range contains 1, its cardinality is at least 1
      have h4 : Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range ≥ 1 := by
        apply Nat.succ_le_of_lt
        apply Nat.card_pos_iff.mpr
        exact ⟨1, h3⟩
      exact h4
    rw [h1]
    intro h3
    linarith
  · -- Prove K.index ≤ n.factorial
    have h1 : H.normalCore.index = Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
      have h2 : H.normalCore = (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).ker := by
        rw [Subgroup.normalCore_eq_ker]
      rw [h2]
      rw [Subgroup.index_ker]
    have h2 : Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range ≤ Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) := by
      -- The range is a subgroup of the permutation group
      apply Nat.card_le_of_injective
      exact Subgroup.coe_injective
    have h3 : Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) = (Nat.card (G ⧸ H))! := by
      rw [Nat.card_perm]
    have h4 : Nat.card (G ⧸ H) = n := by
      -- The cardinality of the coset space equals the index
      have h5 : H.index = Nat.card (G ⧸ H) := by
        rw [Subgroup.index_eq_card]
      rw [hH] at h5
      exact h5.symm
    have h5 : Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) = n.factorial := by
      rw [h3, h4]
    have h6 : Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range ≤ n.factorial := by
      linarith
    rw [h1]
    exact h6","subgoal_id":"construct_action_homomorphism","purpose":"subgoal"}

    (H : Subgroup G) (hH : H.index = n) :
    ∃ K : Subgroup G, K.Normal ∧ K ≤ H ∧ K.index ≠ 0 ∧ K.index ≤ n.factorial := by
  use H.normalCore
  constructor
  · exact Subgroup.normalCore_normal H
  constructor
  · exact Subgroup.normalCore_le H
  constructor
  · -- Prove K.index ≠ 0
    have h1 : H.normalCore.index = Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
      have h2 : H.normalCore = (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).ker := by
        rw [Subgroup.normalCore_eq_ker]
      rw [h2]
      rw [Subgroup.index_ker]
    have h2 : 0 < Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
      -- The range contains at least the identity permutation
      have h3 : (1 : Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) ∈ (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
        -- The homomorphism maps 1 to 1
        have h4 : MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H) 1 = 1 := by
          simp
        exact ⟨1, by simp [h4]⟩
      -- Since the range contains 1, it's non-empty
      have h4 : Nonempty ((MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range : Set _) := ⟨1, h3⟩
      -- The range is finite (as a subgroup of a finite permutation group)
      have h5 : Finite ((MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range : Set _) := by
        apply Finite.of_fintype
        -- The permutation group on G ⧸ H is finite since G ⧸ H has n elements
        infer_instance
      -- Therefore, the cardinality is positive
      have h6 : 0 < Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
        apply Nat.card_pos
        exact ⟨1, h3⟩
        infer_instance
      exact h6
    rw [h1]
    intro h3
    linarith
  · -- Prove K.index ≤ n.factorial
    have h1 : H.normalCore.index = Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
      have h2 : H.normalCore = (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).ker := by
        rw [Subgroup.normalCore_eq_ker]
      rw [h2]
      rw [Subgroup.index_ker]
    have h2 : Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range ≤ Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) := by
      -- The range is a subgroup of the permutation group
      apply Nat.card_le_of_injective
      exact Subgroup.coe_injective
    have h3 : Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) = (Nat.card (G ⧸ H))! := by
      rw [Nat.card_perm]
    have h4 : Nat.card (G ⧸ H) = n := by
      -- The cardinality of the coset space equals the index
      have h5 : H.index = Nat.card (G ⧸ H) := by
        rw [Subgroup.index_eq_card]
      rw [hH] at h5
      exact h5.symm
    have h5 : Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) = n.factorial := by
      rw [h3, h4]
    have h6 : Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range ≤ n.factorial := by
      linarith
    rw [h1]
    exact h6","subgoal_id":"construct_action_homomorphism","purpose":"subgoal"}

    have h2 : 0 < Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
      -- The range contains at least the identity permutation
      have h3 : (1 : Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) ∈ (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
        -- The homomorphism maps 1 to 1
        have h4 : MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H) 1 = 1 := by
          simp
        exact ⟨1, by simp [h4]⟩
      -- Since the range contains 1, it's non-empty, so its cardinality is positive
      have h4 : 0 < Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
        apply Nat.card_pos
        exact ⟨1, h3⟩
        infer_instance

    rw [h1]
    intro h3
    have h4 : Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range = 0 := h3
    have h5 : 0 < Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := h2

      have h2 : H.normalCore = (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).ker := by

{"code":"theorem fateh_001_subgroup_normal_index_le_factorial {G : Type} [Group G] {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (H : Subgroup G) (hH : H.index = n) :
    ∃ K : Subgroup G, K.Normal ∧ K ≤ H ∧ K.index ≠ 0 ∧ K.index ≤ n.factorial := by
  use H.normalCore
  constructor
  · exact Subgroup.normalCore_normal H
  constructor
  · exact Subgroup.normalCore_le H
  constructor
  · -- Prove K.index ≠ 0
    have h1 : H.normalCore.index = Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
      have h2 : H.normalCore = (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).ker := by
        rw [Subgroup.normalCore_eq_ker]
      rw [h2]
      rw [Subgroup.index_ker]
    have h2 : 0 < Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
      -- The range contains at least the identity permutation
      have h3 : (1 : Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) ∈ (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
        -- The homomorphism maps 1 to 1
        have h4 : MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H) 1 = 1 := by
          simp
        exact ⟨1, by simp [h4]⟩
      -- Since the range contains 1, it's non-empty, so its cardinality is positive
      have h4 : 0 < Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
        apply Nat.card_pos
        exact ⟨1, h3⟩
        infer_instance
      exact h4
    rw [h1]
    intro h3
    have h4 : Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range = 0 := h3
    have h5 : 0 < Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := h2
    exact Nat.lt_asymm h5 (by linarith [h4])
  · -- Prove K.index ≤ n.factorial
    have h1 : H.normalCore.index = Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
      have h2 : H.normalCore = (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).ker := by
        rw [Subgroup.normalCore_eq_ker]
      rw [h2]
      rw [Subgroup.index_ker]
    have h2 : (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range ≤ ⊤ := by
      exact Subgroup.le_top
    have h3 : Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range ≤ Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) := by
      -- The range is a subgroup of the permutation group
      apply Subgroup.card_le_of_le
      exact h2
      infer_instance
    have h4 : Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) = (Nat.card (G ⧸ H)).factorial := by
      rw [Nat.card_perm]
    have h5 : Nat.card (G ⧸ H) = n := by
      -- The cardinality of the coset space equals the index
      have h6 : H.index = Nat.card (G ⧸ H) := by
        rw [Subgroup.index_eq_card]
      rw [hH] at h6
      exact h6.symm
    have h6 : Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) = n.factorial := by
      rw [h4, h5]
    have h7 : Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range ≤ n.factorial := by
      calc
        Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range ≤ Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) := h3
        _ = n.factorial := by rw [h6]
    rw [h1]
    exact h7","subgoal_id":"construct_action_homomorphism","purpose":"subgoal"}

{"code":"theorem fateh_001_subgroup_normal_index_le_factorial {G : Type} [Group G] {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (H : Subgroup G) (hH : H.index = n) :
    ∃ K : Subgroup G, K.Normal ∧ K ≤ H ∧ K.index ≠ 0 ∧ K.index ≤ n.factorial := by
  use H.normalCore
  constructor
  · exact Subgroup.normalCore_normal H
  constructor
  · exact Subgroup.normalCore_le H
  constructor
  · -- Prove K.index ≠ 0
    have h1 : H.normalCore.index = Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
      have h2 : H.normalCore = (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).ker := by
        rw [Subgroup.normalCore_eq_ker]
      rw [h2]
      rw [Subgroup.index_ker]
    have h2 : 0 < Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
      -- The range contains at least the identity permutation
      have h3 : (1 : Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) ∈ (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
        -- The homomorphism maps 1 to 1
        have h4 : MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H) 1 = 1 := by
          simp
        exact ⟨1, by simp [h4]⟩
      -- Since the range contains 1, it's non-empty, so its cardinality is positive
      have h4 : 0 < Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
        apply Nat.card_pos
        exact ⟨1, h3⟩
        infer_instance
      exact h4
    rw [h1]
    intro h3
    have h4 : Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range = 0 := h3
    have h5 : 0 < Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := h2
    exact Nat.not_lt_zero (Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range) h5
  · -- Prove K.index ≤ n.factorial
    have h1 : H.normalCore.index = Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
      have h2 : H.normalCore = (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).ker := by
        rw [Subgroup.normalCore_eq_ker]
      rw [h2]
      rw [Subgroup.index_ker]
    have h2 : (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range ≤ ⊤ := by
      exact le_top
    have h3 : Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range ≤ Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) := by
      -- The range is a subgroup of the permutation group
      apply Subgroup.card_le_of_le
      exact h2
      infer_instance
    have h4 : Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) = (Nat.card (G ⧸ H)).factorial := by
      rw [Nat.card_perm]
    have h5 : Nat.card (G ⧸ H) = n := by
      -- The cardinality of the coset space equals the index
      have h6 : H.index = Nat.card (G ⧸ H) := by
        rw [Subgroup.index_eq_card]
      rw [hH] at h6
      exact h6.symm
    have h6 : Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) = n.factorial := by
      rw [h4, h5]
    have h7 : Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range ≤ n.factorial := by
      calc
        Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range ≤ Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) := h3
        _ = n.factorial := by rw [h6]
    rw [h1]
    exact h7","subgoal_id":"construct_action_homomorphism","purpose":"subgoal"}

{"code":"theorem fateh_001_subgroup_normal_index_le_factorial {G : Type} [Group G] {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (H : Subgroup G) (hH : H.index = n) :
    ∃ K : Subgroup G, K.Normal ∧ K ≤ H ∧ K.index ≠ 0 ∧ K.index ≤ n.factorial := by
  use H.normalCore
  constructor
  · exact Subgroup.normalCore_normal H
  constructor
  · exact Subgroup.normalCore_le H
  constructor
  · -- Prove K.index ≠ 0
    have h1 : H.normalCore.index = Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
      have h2 : H.normalCore = (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).ker := by
        rw [Subgroup.normalCore_eq_ker]
      rw [h2]
      rw [Subgroup.index_ker]
    have h2 : 0 < Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
      -- The range contains at least the identity permutation
      have h3 : (1 : Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) ∈ (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
        -- The homomorphism maps 1 to 1
        have h4 : MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H) 1 = 1 := by
          simp
        exact ⟨1, by simp [h4]⟩
      -- Since the range contains 1, it's non-empty, so its cardinality is positive
      have h4 : 0 < Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
        apply Nat.card_pos
        exact ⟨1, h3⟩
        infer_instance
      exact h4
    rw [h1]
    intro h3
    have h4 : Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range = 0 := h3
    have h5 : 0 < Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := h2
    exact Nat.not_lt_zero (Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range) h5
  · -- Prove K.index ≤ n.factorial
    have h1 : H.normalCore.index = Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
      have h2 : H.normalCore = (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).ker := by
        rw [Subgroup.normalCore_eq_ker]
      rw [h2]
      rw [Subgroup.index_ker]
    have h2 : (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range ≤ ⊤ := by
      exact le_top
    have h3 : Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range ≤ Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) := by
      -- The range is a subgroup of the permutation group
      apply Subgroup.card_le_of_le
      exact h2
      infer_instance
    have h4 : Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) = (Nat.card (G ⧸ H)).factorial := by
      rw [Nat.card_perm]
    have h5 : Nat.card (G ⧸ H) = n := by
      -- The cardinality of the coset space equals the index
      have h6 : H.index = Nat.card (G ⧸ H) := by
        rw [Subgroup.index_eq_card]
      rw [hH] at h6
      exact h6.symm
    have h6 : Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) = n.factorial := by
      rw [h4, h5]
    have h7 : Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range ≤ n.factorial := by
      calc
        Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range ≤ Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) := h3
        _ = n.factorial := by rw [h6]
    rw [h1]
    exact h7","subgoal_id":"construct_action_homomorphism","purpose":"subgoal"}

{"code":"theorem fateh_001_subgroup_normal_index_le_factorial {G : Type} [Group G] {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (H : Subgroup G) (hH : H.index = n) :
    ∃ K : Subgroup G, K.Normal ∧ K ≤ H ∧ K.index ≠ 0 ∧ K.index ≤ n.factorial := by
  use H.normalCore
  constructor
  · exact Subgroup.normalCore_normal H
  constructor
  · exact Subgroup.normalCore_le H
  constructor
  · -- Prove K.index ≠ 0
    have h1 : H.normalCore.index = Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
      have h2 : H.normalCore = (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).ker := by
        rw [Subgroup.normalCore_eq_ker]
      rw [h2]
      rw [Subgroup.index_ker]
    have h2 : 0 < Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
      -- The range contains at least the identity permutation
      have h3 : (1 : Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) ∈ (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
        -- The homomorphism maps 1 to 1
        have h4 : MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H) 1 = 1 := by
          simp
        exact ⟨1, by simp [h4]⟩
      -- Since the range contains 1, it's non-empty, so its cardinality is positive
      have h4 : 0 < Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
        apply Nat.card_pos
        exact ⟨1, h3⟩
        infer_instance
      exact h4
    rw [h1]
    intro h3
    have h4 : Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range = 0 := h3
    have h5 : 0 < Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := h2
    exact Nat.not_lt_zero (Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range) h5
  · -- Prove K.index ≤ n.factorial
    have h1 : H.normalCore.index = Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range := by
      have h2 : H.normalCore = (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).ker := by
        rw [Subgroup.normalCore_eq_ker]
      rw [h2]
      rw [Subgroup.index_ker]
    have h2 : (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range ≤ ⊤ := by
      exact le_top
    have h3 : Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range ≤ Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) := by
      -- The range is a subgroup of the permutation group
      apply Subgroup.card_le_of_le
      exact h2
      infer_instance
    have h4 : Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) = (Nat.card (G ⧸ H)).factorial := by
      rw [Nat.card_perm]
    have h5 : Nat.card (G ⧸ H) = n := by
      -- The cardinality of the coset space equals the index
      have h6 : H.index = Nat.card (G ⧸ H) := by
        rw [Subgroup.index_eq_card]
      rw [hH] at h6
      exact h6.symm
    have h6 : Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) = n.factorial := by
      rw [h4, h5]
    have h7 : Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range ≤ n.factorial := by
      calc
        Nat.card (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).range ≤ Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) := h3
        _ = n.factorial := by rw [h6]
    rw [h1]
    exact h7","subgoal_id":"construct_action_homomorphism","purpose":"subgoal"}
